name: Basap
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.note: Glottolog lists only comparative/classificatory sources (Smith 2017, Smith & Rama 2022); no descriptive phonology found.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3 languoid page basa1286 and reference pages 314104, 326525.
sources.note: Only two descriptive references (the two Indonesian sketches above) plus Smith 2017 and Smith & Rama 2022 for classification; no dialects or alternate names listed; no 'Lebbo'' languoid in Glottolog.

sources.citation: Smith, Alexander D. 2018. The Barito Linkage Hypothesis, with a Note on the Position of Basap. JSEALS 11(1).
sources.note: Open-access comparative note on Basap; low chance of a stress statement but the only modern first-hand Basap data in English.

sources.citation: Guerreiro, Antonio J. 2015. The Lebbo' language and culture: A window on Borneo's ancient past. In I Wayan Arka, Ni Luh Nyoman Seri Malini & Ida Ayu Made Puspani (eds.), Language documentation and cultural practices in the Austronesian world: Papers from 12-ICAL, Volume 4, 149-177. Canberra: Asia-Pacific Linguistics (ANU).
sources.note: Nothing. The chapter (pp. 149-177, Lebbo' = a Basap variety of the Lesan/Kelai area, Berau) is ethnohistory plus lexical comparison tables and morphology notes; the only phonological remark is footnote 4 (p. 153): 'the phonology of Lebbo'.. does not exhibit specific features.. orthographic symbols correspond to phonemic notation in IPA' (orthography key). No mention of stress, accent, or syllable prominence anywhere in the chapter.

sources.citation: Ibrahim, Sjahrial S. A. R., Rustam Effendi & M. P. Lambut. 1991. Struktur Bahasa Bosap. Jakarta: Departemen Pendidikan dan Kebudayaan. xv+144 pp.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: a digital copy exists, HathiTrust search-only
sources.note: The only phonology-bearing description of Basap (Wikipedia's consonant and vowel tables are drawn from it). Pusat Bahasa 'Struktur Bahasa' sketches almost always have a 'Tekanan' (stress) subsection in the phonology chapter, so this is the most likely place for a word-stress statement. Describes the Bosap of Jitan village, Loa Kulu, Kutai.

sources.citation: Kawi, Djantera, Durdje Durasid & Aris Djinal. 1985. Morfosintaksis bahasa Basap. Jakarta: Pusat Pembinaan dan Pengembangan Bahasa. v+91 pp.
